name: echo server rack
description: Proposal, the lab, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x moved left beside a steel rack of nine units, two columns of green LEDs twinkling on their own rhythms): it watches and blinks, the fifth unit's LEDs go red and blink, it looks over with an antenna ping, brings a forearm out of its arm stub and pats the faulty unit twice with the rack jolting a cell on each pat, the unit comes back green, and it nods with its eyes shut happy and a ping before it goes back to watching; judge whether the red row reads as the fault at a glance, whether the pats read as pats at 12 px cells, and whether it is still this creature.
